<!--
Thanks for this. You don't need to be a developer to file a useful request —
the most valuable part is the first question, and you can usually answer it
just by playing.
-->

## Which game?

<!-- Name and, if you have it, the Steam app id. -->

## Does your character survive on someone else's machine?

This is the question that decides whether a game can work at all. If your
character, inventory, and progress are tied to whoever is hosting, embersave
cannot help — the world would reset for everyone but the host.

**How to check, if you haven't already:** play a session on one person's
machine, then have a different person host the same world, and join it. Is
your character still there, with your stuff?

- [ ] Yes — everything came across
- [ ] No — I lost my character or progress
- [ ] Not sure / haven't tried

Anything you noticed while testing:

<!-- e.g. "kept the character but lost base ownership", "had to re-invite" -->

## How does the game save?

Skip anything you don't know.

- Does it ship a dedicated server, or is it host-only?
- Roughly how big is a save after a few weeks?
- Where does it keep saves on disk?

## Who's asking?

<!--
How many of you play it, and how you handle hosting today — waiting on one
person, renting a server, passing files around by hand. This helps work out
what to build next.
-->
